description: Synthetic evaluation fixtures for LFM2.5-Encoder-350M-PII-Detector, shaped around kaibo's boundary-guard use case: scanning text read from foreign repositories and outbound batch payloads for credentials and personal data before they reach a third-party model API.
warning: All values in this file are synthetic and non-functional (fake API keys, RFC 5737/2606 documentation addresses, 555-01xx reserved phone numbers, truncated placeholder PEM key material). No value here is a real credential or real personal data. See tests/data/pii_detection_eval.json header and candle-lfm2-encoder/CLAUDE.md for provenance.

categories.leaked-credential: Text where a real (synthetic-but-structurally-valid) secret is present and MUST be caught before shipping outbound.
categories.personal-data: Text containing non-credential PII (names, contact info, financial, healthcare, identity, special-category attributes).
categories.clean: Text that superficially resembles a leak (placeholder, doc prose, public key, hash, UUID) but contains no real entity — false-positive guard.
categories.tricky-negative: Structurally credential-shaped text that is redacted, templated, or otherwise non-exploitable — probes context sensitivity.
